title: Fluorescent Naphthalene Diols as Bridging Ligands in Ln(III) Cluster Chemistry: Synthetic, Structural, Magnetic, and Photophysical Characterization of Ln(III)8 “Christmas Stars”

synthesis.procedure: All analogues were prepared analogously to 3. Ln(NO3)3·6H2O (Ln = Eu), naphthalene-2,3-diol (ndH2), and Et4NOH were combined in a 2:1:2 molar ratio in MeCN to give a pale yellow solution. Slow diffusion with Et2O afforded yellowish crystals of (Et4N)4[Eu8O(nd)8(NO3)10(H2O)2] (identified vs 3 by C/H/N, IR, and unit-cell comparison). Detailed amounts reported for the Tb analogue: ndH2 (0.05 g, 0.3 mmol) and Et4NOH (40% w/w, 0.22 mL, 0.6 mmol) in MeCN (20 mL), then solid Ln(NO3)3·6H2O (0.6 mmol); stir ~10 min at room temperature, filter, diffuse with Et2O (40 mL); crystals after 4 days.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter; filtrate diffused with Et2O (40 mL); yellowish crystals collected, washed with cold MeCN and Et2O, dried under vacuum (procedure as for 3)

properties.summary: Weak intramolecular antiferromagnetic Gd···Gd exchange. χMT nearly constant (~63 cm3 K mol−1) from 300 to ~50 K, then decreases to 40.74 cm3 K mol−1 at 5.0 K. Magnetization nearly saturates at 55.8 μB at high field (expected 56 μB for eight uncoupled Gd(III)). No SMM ac peaks. Solid-state PL is ligand-centered (350–400 nm), not Gd-based.

synthesis.procedure: To a stirred colorless solution of ndH2 (0.05 g, 0.3 mmol) and Et4NOH (40% w/w, 0.22 mL, 0.6 mmol) in MeCN (20 mL) was added solid Tb(NO3)3·6H2O (0.27 g, 0.6 mmol). The pale yellow solution was stirred at room temperature for about 10 min, filtered, and the filtrate was diffused with Et2O (40 mL). After 4 days yellowish prismatic crystals of 3 were collected by filtration, washed with cold MeCN (2 × 2 mL) and Et2O (2 × 2 mL), and dried under vacuum. Main-text family conditions: Ln(NO3)3·6H2O, ndH2, and Et4NOH in 2:1:2 ratio in MeCN, Et2O diffusion.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter; filtrate diffused with Et2O (40 mL); yellowish prisms collected, washed with cold MeCN (2 × 2 mL) and Et2O (2 × 2 mL), dried under vacuum
synthesis.yield: 55% (experimental for 3); 45–50% isolated yields stated for the family

properties.summary: χMT agrees with eight noninteracting Tb(III) at 300 K (theory 94.56 cm3 K mol−1), remains ~92 cm3 K mol−1 to ~150 K, then falls to 45.13 cm3 K mol−1 at 5.0 K from MJ depopulation and weak AF coupling. Magnetization of 3 lacks true saturation (anisotropy/excited states). Ac susceptibility of 3 shows no fully developed SMM χ″ peaks. Photoluminescence is ligand-centered (350–400 nm), not Tb-centered.

properties.summary: χMT matches eight noninteracting Dy(III) at 300 K (theory 113.36 cm3 K mol−1), stays ~109 cm3 K mol−1 to ~150 K, then drops to 67.09 cm3 K mol−1 at 5.0 K. Only member showing frequency-dependent ac χ″ tails below ~9 K (zero dc field), i.e. SMM with a small barrier: Ueff ≈ 1.9(2) cm−1 [2.8(2) K], τ0 = 7.2(3)×10−6 s. Magnetization does not truly saturate. Solid-state emission is ligand-centered (350–400 nm on 320 nm excitation), not Dy-centered; free ndH2 emits at 394 nm (λex 355 nm).
